# `core/memory/ObjectPool.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/ObjectPool.js`

ObjectPool.js - Zero-allocation object pooling for GC reduction Pools commonly allocated objects during chunk processing: - Vec3/Vec4 temporary vectors - Chunk info objects - Ray hit results - TypedArray views
